summary: Candidate research only; no dataset acquired. NJDOH’s public hospital report gives a facility-level snapshot for Saint Peter’s with hospital-wide bed categories and selected service counts. NJDOH’s facility search is a public query route for county and licensed service listings, but its page did not expose result rows in this inspection. RWJUH’s public map labels campus buildings and landmarks, but no publication date was visible. These sources do not establish a room- or unit-level inventory or a crosswalk to CMS CCNs; independently verify before use.

sources.title: Hospital Performance Report: St. Peter's University Hospital
sources.geography: Saint Peter’s University Hospital, New Brunswick, Middlesex County, NJ
sources.period: Current report page observed; license expiration shown as 2026-03-31. Snapshot/effective date of bed and service values not stated.
sources.grain: Hospital-level; bed categories and counts for selected services/equipment. Not unit, room, or bed identifiers.
useful_fields: Hospital bed categories: medical/surgical, OB/GYN, pediatric, adult ICU/CCU, pediatric ICU, neonatal and intermediate bassinets
Selected service/equipment counts: mixed ORs, cystoscopy, cardiac catheterization labs, acute hemodialysis, linear accelerators, hyperbaric chambers
observed_facts: The page identifies St. Peter’s University Hospital in Middlesex County at 254 Easton Ave, New Brunswick, and gives facility number 11205.
It reports hospital-level category counts, including 268 medical/surgical beds, 77 OB/GYN beds, 40 pediatric beds, and 8 pediatric ICU beds; these are not location-specific inventories.
The page reports selected service/equipment counts, but does not say where within the campus they are located.
sources.retrieval_next_step: Retrieve and archive the page as a dated public response; record its retrieval date and source hash. Reconcile facility number 11205 to the relevant CMS CCN using an independently verified crosswalk. Treat all counts as report-page values with unstated snapshot date until NJDOH confirms effective dates.
limitations: Public page inspection did not establish a reuse license; preserve attribution and verify redistribution terms.
No rooms, named units, physical/staffed bed distinction, map, or opening/closure history.
Current page values may not be comparable with CMS data without confirming period and definitions.

sources.title: New Jersey Hospitals, Ambulatory Care, and other Acute Care Facilities search
sources.geography: New Jersey; query supports county and facility/service selection, including Middlesex County
sources.period: Live query page inspected; records’ effective dates are not shown on the query form.
sources.grain: Licensed facility/service listing; result-level grain and identifiers require retrieval and inspection.
useful_fields: Facility type, including General Acute Care Hospital
Facility name/address and licensed facility details in results, subject to verification
Ambulatory care service categories including MRI, PET, satellite emergency department, and hospital-based off-site ambulatory care
observed_facts: The official NJDOH query form supports searches by county and facility type/service.

NJDOH explicitly cautions that ambulatory-care searches exclude services provided by hospitals and listed on the hospital license; the resulting free-standing facility query is not a complete hospital-campus capability inventory.
The page links to the acute-care facilities Excel download from the parent facility-search page; the direct workbook URL is listed as a retrieval lead and was not opened or verified in this task.
sources.retrieval_next_step: Use the interactive query for Middlesex County and General Acute Care Hospital, then open each relevant facility result and capture identifiers, license/service details, and any displayed dates. Separately retrieve the workbook through NJDOH’s published link and inspect its sheet names, columns, update date, and terms before treating it as a dataset.
limitations: The search page opened, but did not return inspected result rows in this task; direct workbook URL is unverified.
Hospital-listed services must be obtained from each hospital license/result, not inferred from the free-standing ambulatory service search.
No unit, room, or bed-location topology.

It labels an Emergency Room and a Center for Wound Healing, but map labels alone do not establish the full set of services or operating status.
The inspected PDF has two pages, but no map date was visible in extracted page text.
sources.retrieval_next_step: Save the PDF with retrieval date and hash; inspect the rendered pages for any date or legend not exposed in text. Use the labels only as candidate campus entities, then reconcile them to current first-party service/location pages or facility records. Keep the map’s publication date unknown unless verified.
limitations: Date and update history unknown; it may be historical.
No floor/unit/room/bed locations, identifiers, capacities, effective opening/closure dates, or redistribution license found.
Labels are a visitor-orientation map and should not be treated as a complete operational topology.
